title: Dune
description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world where the only thing of value is a spice capable of extending life and expanding consciousness.

title: Neuromancer
description: The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel. Case was the sharpest data-thief in the matrix--until he crossed the wrong people and they crippled his nervous system.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
description: A groundbreaking work of science fiction, the novel follows Genly Ai, an envoy to the planet Gethen, where inhabitants are ambisexual and have no fixed gender.

title: Fahrenheit 451
description: Guy Montag is a fireman who burns books in a future American society where television is the dominant entertainment and critical thought is discouraged.
Among the seminal texts of the 20th century, the novel is a rare work that grows more haunting as its dystopian purgatory becomes more real.

title: Sapiens
description: From a renowned historian comes a groundbreaking narrative of humanity's creation and evolution that explores the ways in which biology and history have defined us.

title: Gone Girl
description: On a warm summer morning in North Carthage, Missouri, it is Nick and Amy Dunne's fifth wedding anniversary. Presents are being wrapped and reservations are being made when Nick's clever and beautiful wife disappears.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
description: Mikael Blomkvist, a once-respected financial journalist, watches his professional life rapidly crumble around him. Meanwhile, Lisbeth Salander, a resourceful hacker, is hired to investigate Blomkvist.

title: Project Hail Mary
description: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission to save Earth -- and his own life along with it. But he can't remember his own name, let alone the nature of his assignment or how to complete it.

title: The Martian
description: I'm pretty much fucked. That's my honest assessment. I'm going to have to science the shit out of this. Stranded astronaut Mark Watney must use his wits to survive on Mars.

title: Building Software Systems
description: A practical guide to building reliable software systems through engineering principles, testing methodologies, and system design patterns.

title: Atomic Habits
description: No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving every day. James Clear reveals practical strategies that will teach you how to form good habits.

title: The Silent Patient
description: Alicia Berenson's life is seemingly perfect until one evening she shoots her husband five times in the face. And then she never speaks another word.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
description: For years, rumors of the 'Marsh Girl' have haunted Barkley Cove. Kya Clark is the Marsh Girl, barefoot and wild. She is sensitive and intelligent but has been alone for years.

title: Piranesi
description: Piranesi's house is no ordinary building: its rooms are infinite, its corridors endless, its walls are lined with thousands upon thousands of statues. He lives in the House.

title: The Name of the Wind
description: Told in Kvothe's own voice, this is the tale of the magically gifted young man who grows to be the most notorious wizard his world has ever seen.

title: A Game of Thrones
description: Long ago, in a time forgotten, a preternatural event threw the seasons out of balance. In a land where summers can last decades and winters a lifetime, trouble is brewing.

title: The Hobbit
description: Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable, unambitious life, rarely traveling any farther than his pantry or cellar. But his contentment is disturbed when Gandalf arrives.

title: Brave New World
description: Aldous Huxley's profoundly important classic of world literature: a searching vision of an unequal, technologically-advanced future where humans are genetically bred and pharmaceutically anesthetized.

title: The Bell Jar
description: Esther Greenwood is brilliant, beautiful, and terrifically talented, but she is slowly going under for the last time in her life.

title: All the Light We Cannot See
description: A blind French girl and a German boy whose paths collide in occupied France as both try to survive the devastation of World War II.

title: Station Eleven

title: Snow Crash
